questions.question: What good thing did Joash do early in his reign?
options: Repaired the house of the LORD
questions.answer: Repaired the house of the LORD

questions.question: What did Joash do after Jehoiada the priest died?
options: Set free all the slaves of Judah
Built a second temple to the LORD
Abandoned the LORD and served idols
Continued all the reforms he had begun
questions.answer: Abandoned the LORD and served idols

questions.question: Joash had Zechariah the son of Jehoiada stoned to death for rebuking the people.
Money was collected for temple repairs in a _____ at the gate.
Joash was killed by his own _____ on his bed.
